pkgmetadata.longdescription: Ship of Harkinian is a native PC port of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. It includes enhancements and a built-in randomizer, but does not include Nintendo game assets. A legally obtained supported game dump is required to generate the user's game-data archive.

use.flag: Build Ship of Harkinian's SDL2_net remote-control support.
Build Linux text-to-speech support using eSpeak NG.
